_comment: Copy to boards.local.json (gitignored) and fill in your boards. serial = the board USB serial (picotool info, or the bench's board_usb_serial line). role = vehicle or station. probe = true only on the board the debug probe is wired to; the gate still confirms it by chip ID. board = optional board profile name from board_profiles.json (feather_rp2350, fruit_jam); with it the bench checks that board's expected hardware, without it the bench keeps its legacy rules. See docs/FLASHING.md, Board roles (local config).
